methods.description: Exact tree-bound missing-object batch import for declared selected native/source banks and direct additive assets. Existing trusted scientific checks still execute; structured stage clocks distinguish metadata, transport, native and continuous checker cost. Follow-up requests the locally resolved immutable root tree OID, matching the actual GitHub tree-envelope contract without relaxing exact path binding.

limits: Acquisition only, not a complete scientific dependency closure or scientific proof. Unknown/deeper historical inputs retain the existing checker path.

First active ordinary hosted gate used safe fallback because a commit-addressed GitHub tree envelope echoed the commit OID. Root-addressed metadata and actual production ls-tree binding now pass a metadata-only control. No successful hosted acquisition or speedup is claimed; the next ordinary gate must measure it.
